planets.name: XO-1 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of XO-1 with a 3.94-day year, found in 2006.

text.card: XO-1 b was found in 2006 by XO as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around XO-1. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2006, disc_facility XO, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.941505, pl_radj 1.14, pl_bmassj 0.83

quotes.title: XO-1b
quotes.card: XO-1b is an extrasolar planet approximately 536 light-years away from Earth.
